categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies txdownloadman_impl.cpp to filter out consensus-invalid transactions from the compact block extrapool cache.
categories.rationale: Prevents consensus-invalid transactions from occupying space in the compact block extrapool cache. Because consensus-invalid transactions can never legitimately appear in a valid block, filtering them avoids polluting cache capacity needed for compact block reconstruction.
